lessons.parent_failure: Parent gave insufficient branch evidence
lessons.rule: Before coding, record early exits and mutually exclusive branches with original addresses. Review special-value equality collisions, such as unit job255 matching a job255 entry.
lessons.evidence: Same-item replacement erroneously called the final callback; independent job255 handling cleared a field on the normal matching branch.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent did not specify fixture fidelity
lessons.rule: Keep source declarations intact; use const fixtures and independently derived fixed vectors. Do not redefine const or alter the function under test to fit a fixture.
lessons.evidence: Random-item harness initially removed const and mirrored the implementation as its only oracle.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent omitted dependency discovery instructions
lessons.rule: Resolve call targets through ld/rom.ld, source declarations, and symbol tables before inventing names. Report unknown verified targets. UNINVENTORIED is a missing-reference warning, not a blocked compilation.
lessons.evidence: Agents invented a name for already recovered ApplyItemAbilityFlags and mistook probe warning for failure.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent selected compiler edge cases without strategy
lessons.rule: State a concrete compiler hypothesis, make one natural-source change, record probe result and source hash, retain semantically correct best candidate. A close byte count cannot justify incorrect behavior.
lessons.evidence: Initial four-byte matching tasks produced little accepted recovery; corrected replacement semantics increased the mismatch.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent repaired too much directly
lessons.rule: Return actionable evidence and ask the same agent to repair its own work, update a regression, and explain the generalized lesson. Parent edits only for integration or a documented escalation.
lessons.evidence: Parent corrected replacement control flow and fixtures itself during the first pilot.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent provided weak acceptance criteria for tests
lessons.rule: Test distinguishing cases, no-op callback counts, whole-state collateral writes, and signed/narrowing boundaries. Prefer real recovered dependencies; explicitly label stubs and uncounted candidates. For destructive traversals, verify the owner root at every dependency call and compare the whole expected state after callback mutations; a final null root and call trace alone miss premature owner writes.
lessons.evidence: Support7 single-item test did not distinguish the exception from ordinary acceptance; fake paired-state helper duplicated recovered code. Session44 omitted requested call-time state assertions; parent made the concrete premature-root-clear counterexample explicit.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent did not require explicit loop entry and back-edge evidence
lessons.rule: Map the initial branch target, each back-edge, fallthrough, and every index/pointer update before coding a loop. Trace zero, one and two iterations independently from original instructions; do not derive the only test oracle from the proposed C. Verify documentation branch addresses and polarity against raw disassembly.
lessons.evidence: Session 5 incremented after holes even though caaf6 branches past cab08/cab0a/cab0c; mirrored harness passed. Session39 source and harness both followed one link too early because the initial branch bypassed the load. Parent prompt cited loops but failed to require entry-target evidence. Session38 research table also transcribed branch addresses/polarity incorrectly.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent did not distinguish live-registry checks from stable fixtures
lessons.rule: Use synthetic fixtures for exact expected aggregate counts; production registries get invariant checks. Validate distinct agent identities as well as numeric IDs, and finite timing values. Optional partial timestamps remain valid and unmeasured; missing time is not an error or zero.
lessons.evidence: Session 4 test hardcoded three reviewed sessions against the evolving registry.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent requested roundtrip without enough independent schema evidence
lessons.rule: Verify field semantics against an independent recovered reader or target disassembly. Reject malformed encodings by decoded width. Ensure negative tests mutate the intended named field and check the intended failure.
lessons.evidence: Session 6 raw hex could shrink an encoded record; positional packed-field negative test targeted the wrong field.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent did not require literal-pool address verification independent of harness
lessons.rule: Record numeric radix explicitly and check resolved addresses from original literal words. Fixtures must not share an unchecked offset with the implementation; include a decoy at plausible wrong offsets. Verify callback interleaving, not only per-callback counts.
lessons.evidence: Session 5 used decimal968 where ROM literal is hex0x968; its mirrored offset harness passed.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent manually converted a manifest address incorrectly and phrased permission ambiguously
lessons.rule: Derive hex addresses mechanically from the authoritative manifest; conflicting prompt bounds must be reconciled before probing. State explicitly that multiple bounded hypothesis probes are allowed after the shared ELF lease.
lessons.evidence: Session10 caught CBCE0 vs actualCB4E0; session8 interpreted once allowed as one probe.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent did not specify separately linkable outputs for nonadjacent data intervals
lessons.rule: Each nonadjacent ROM interval must emit an independently placeable object or explicitly placed section. Neighboring symbol addresses give upper bounds, not proof all intervening bytes share a schema.
lessons.evidence: Session9 initially rendered distant tables contiguously and proposed251 records from adjacent symbol; narrowedto86 and requested separateoutputs.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent did not require register provenance for research claims
lessons.rule: Trace each load to its actual base and last arithmetic assignment. Nearby pointer chains are not evidence of a pointer field in the indexed record. Distinguish instruction extent, literal pools, and alignment when reporting recovery blocks. End addresses are exclusive: include the full last instruction before labeling any following bytes padding.
lessons.evidence: Session13 mistook helperfilledstacklistpointer for contentrecordfield; actualrecordreadbyte+32.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent ran full discovery while workers were editing test/source files
lessons.rule: Before a full integration gate, request a short write freeze from all active coding agents, not only a shared ELF lease. Focused immutable artifacts can be checked during work; full discovery waits for stable owned files.
lessons.evidence: Class/fullbatch gates saw transient registry and content-index test failures during activeagentwrites. Session51 full discovery lacked a coordinated freeze; parent centralized the rule in AGENTS rather than relying on packet reminders.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent conflated a function interval with an entire C compilation unit in task-tool requirements
lessons.rule: Isolated probes compile whole source files. Verify translation-unit placement separately from function bounds, suppress unsafe inferred probe commands for shared sources, and keep JSON output parseable under every flag combination.
lessons.evidence: Session17 packet emittedfunctionstartprobe for multifuncsources and mixedrawdisassemblywithJSON.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent did not give old-compiler-compatible layout assertion patterns
lessons.rule: Pinned agbcc GCC2.9 does not support newer builtins such as __builtin_offsetof. Use supported target layout assertions plus original load offsets. Function equality is not full-block equality: emit required end alignment with .align 2,0 and verify padding. Avoid importing modern host stddef macros into target preprocessed C; put native offsetof checks in host harnesses or verify the expanded old-compiler-compatible expression.
lessons.evidence: Session18 headerbuiltinfailedtargetcompile; matching22bytefunction stilldifferedin2bytealignmentuntilzero-filldirective.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent did not explicitly prohibit oracle setup from satisfying the actual test outputs
lessons.rule: Calculate expected mutations on separate storage; actual outputs must start with distinguishable sentinel values before the tested call. A no-op or missing-store mutant must fail. Linker start-plus-constant assertions do not measure function size; use the strict symbol comparison gate.
lessons.evidence: Session20 oracle initialized realexternaloutputs beforecall; session18 linker sizeassertion merelyrecheckedstart.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent serialized independent leaf probes behind unnecessary shared-ELF leases
lessons.rule: Leaf probes with no undefined symbols need no reference ELF. For dependencies, use an immutable verified reference snapshot and record its hash; keep final matching admission on the integrated build. Prefer atomic manifest writes and a short source-write freeze only for full gates.
lessons.evidence: Sessions18/19/20/21/22waitedforunrelatedELFrelinks despiteleafcode; session23 assignedisolationtooling.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent delegated carving into an unreadable one-line build object list
lessons.rule: Keep OBJS one object per line; replace only the bounded copied object sequence. Compare the before/after object tokens and verify every unrelated object retains order. A matching gate must pass before publishing a new reference ELF. Search consumers of edited build syntax before changing it; update and test parsers in the same task.
lessons.evidence: Session20 accidentallydroppedunit_pool.o; parentdiffreviewfounditafterundefinedsymbol/downstreamlinkfail. Sameagentrestoresandformatslist.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent integration prompt allowed only one new object although an interior ROM carve requires a suffix too.
lessons.rule: Compute incbin end as offset plus length. Collision-check new source/object filenames. Interior carves may add a matching object and a uniquely named copied suffix while preserving every unrelated object and its order. Derive every interval subtraction mechanically in the plan, including large data suffixes.
lessons.evidence: Session24 initially read the length BDAC8 as an end address and proposed an existing suffix filename; parent review corrected the plan before editing.

lessons.parent_failure: Compiler-shape prompt lacked an explicit bounded hypothesis budget and reusable results artifact.
lessons.rule: For a dedicated compiler-shape research session, record roughly 8–12 distinct natural-source hypotheses, source hashes and symbol/block deltas, retaining the best semantically tested source. Derive branch targets from disassembly rather than manually transcribing addresses. Preserve exact source or executable transformations in tracked research; hashes and ignored temporary paths alone cannot reproduce a compiler trial.
lessons.evidence: Session26 first stopped after two no-effect variants; parent revised prompt, same agent tested12 variants and reduced root-candidate differences12to6. Parent caught documentation target typo, agent decoded original branch to correct it. Sessions38–40 initially stored hypotheses mainly as prose/hash tables or temporary generators; parent strengthened the persisted-artifact contract.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent used the vague requirement guards instead of an explicit whole-state mutation contract.
lessons.rule: For callback traversals, test every stop position on a fixed expected trace, a non-one nonzero continuation, and callback successor mutation. Snapshot whole owner/node fixtures for read-only cases; build mutation expected state on separate storage and compare all bytes, not selected links alone.
lessons.evidence: Sessions27and29 exactsource needed stronger whole-state tests; bothauthorsrevised theirown harnesses.

lessons.parent_failure: Tool prompt did not make whole-ledger validity, action semantics, and filesystem immutability tests explicit.
lessons.rule: Planning tools must validate the whole input partition, distinguish create/edit/retire actions, and reject wrong source kinds. Test read-only behavior by comparing actual fixture paths and bytes before/after, not a returned flag; test real CLI JSON/error exit. Run planners on stable leased working trees and regenerate stale plans. The integration lease must explicitly require retiring superseded incbin wrappers and checking remaining consumers; a matching build alone does not catch orphan files.
lessons.evidence: Session30 sameagent fixed fullpartitionvalidation, remainderextensions, oldsourcepaths and explicit retirement after parentreview; added15focusedtests. Session45 integrated a matching list clear but left the previous copied wrapper on disk; parent returned retirement to the same agent.

lessons.parent_failure: Arithmetic test prompt requested boundary coverage without forbidding a duplicated implementation formula as its oracle.
lessons.rule: Use fixed expected boundary values or an independently derived wider arithmetic oracle for truncation, rounding, wrap, and saturation. Pair callback argument checks with whole initialized caller-owned state comparisons where the wrapper itself should not mutate it.
lessons.evidence: Session32 parent returned duplicate roundingexpression in expectedunits and missingallocation/free callerstate guards.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent explicitly allowed host callback stubs without resolving incompatible production callback function types.
lessons.rule: Recovered callback APIs must use compatible C function-pointer signatures end to end, not just target ABI-compatible casts. Prefer generic void-pointer callback arguments when evidence shows generic containers. Recheck every existing matching function after header changes and test real callback/traversal composition. Never retain or inspect a pointer to expired stack state; capture live values or assert outputs. Inventory and migrate existing test callsites as well as production callers; compile composition harness dependencies as separate translation units.
lessons.evidence: Session34 parentreviewidentified incompatibleTreeTraversalCallback/ListCallbackAppend call; sameauthor assigned genericcompatibleAPI plus realintegrationharness.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent phrase Planapproved after32release could be read as a release announcement.
lessons.rule: Distinguish PLAN APPROVED, HOLD, and LEASE GRANTED NOW in separate explicit messages. A plan approval does not grant shared-file ownership. State the prior owner has released before issuing a grant, and list exact files; use readable spaced sentences.
lessons.evidence: Session34 interpreted ambiguous parent plan approval as release and changed shared callback headers during32integration; parent paused writes, obtained stable states, then explicitly granted lease. No ROM mismatch survived review.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent creation prompt requested native pointer fields without naming known node types or requiring composition with existing owner views.
lessons.rule: Reuse established pointee types; do not make list/tree heads self-pointers to the owner. When a recovered constructor proves full owner layout, reconcile partial views before claiming native end-to-end composition. Verify unchanged target layouts/bytes and test real functions together without incompatible struct casts. For output-pointer APIs, use exactly compatible pointer-to-pointer types; receive void* outputs in void* temporaries before converting the values. Alias fixtures must derive overlap from native offsetof and pointer width rather than assuming the 64-bit host overlap also holds on target.
lessons.evidence: Session36 corrected Container head types; session37 assigned demonstrated partial-owner/native-layout incompatibility for source-first type unification. Session42 initially cast u8** output slots to void**; parent prompt should have required compatible output storage.

lessons.parent_failure: Lifecycle tool prompt introduced timestamps without explicitly extending registry validation or distinguishing atomic writes from writer coordination.
lessons.rule: Validate every newly introduced optional timestamp independently and keep missing times unknown. Document a single-writer lease even when writes use atomic replacement. Exercise each public CLI mutation path on disposable fixtures and keep text/documentation behavior consistent.
lessons.evidence: Session35 added optional registered/reviewed timestamp validation, CLI review output and singlewriter guidance after parent review.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent excluded an entire mixed-purpose file when only two raw-word APIs should remain outside owner-type migration.
lessons.rule: Map ownership at function granularity when a file contains multiple representations. Migrate proven owner-pointer functions consistently; leave raw record APIs unchanged. Do not replace known members with byte-offset casts merely to avoid a type decision.
lessons.evidence: Session37 identified CopyListNodes still used ListCountOwner after parent blanketexcludedaccessors; parent correctedscope and agent migrated only that function, preserving all targetbytes.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent specified bounded CPU execution without a complete machine and comparison contract
lessons.rule: Before implementing differential execution, specify supported ISA and CPU model, reject unsupported state changes/instructions and memory maps, require observable comparisons, distinguish volatile registers from preserved state, and make CLI mismatches fail. Test unsupported cases with independent instruction fixtures.
lessons.evidence: Session41 initial runner used default Unicorn CPU and allowed overly broad mappings and vacuous comparisons; parent review strengthened these constraints before acceptance.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent compressed task packets until important acceptance details were hard to scan
lessons.rule: Use ordinary spacing and short paragraphs for task packets. Separate ownership, original evidence, semantic tests, matching constraints and integration authorization. Give concrete distinguishing examples without burying them in compressed prose.
lessons.evidence: Session43 reported the initial packet was too compressed; a readable follow-up clarified native pointers, retained storage and the callback mutation fixture.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent did not require an explicit comparison scope for every reported byte metric
lessons.rule: Report symbol-aligned differences separately from whole-block differences including alignment/extra bytes. Read each count from its named JSON field and label original versus candidate extents; do not infer block metrics from the function summary.
lessons.evidence: Session46 reported68 symbol differences as block differences; comparison.json recorded70 block differences. Parent requested corrected research and reproduction.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent patch-renderer prompt omitted text boundary cases
lessons.rule: Test generated patches by applying them to independent copies with and without final newlines; emit valid no-newline markers or reject unsupported text explicitly. Rendering plausible diff text alone is not verification. Determine EOF by source line position, not row-text equality; include repeated final-line content in fixtures.
lessons.evidence: Session47 patch deleted a copied wrapper without a final newline incorrectly; parent disposable fixture reproduced git apply failure.

lessons.parent_failure: Parent trusted representation labels without requiring compiler evidence of packing
lessons.rule: Verify representation experiments in preprocessed declarations and emitted field accesses. A type named Packed is not packed without the compiler attribute; require expected size/offsets and byte-vs-halfword access evidence before running variants. Never weaken a size assertion to hide a missing attribute.
lessons.evidence: Session46 ordinary structs emitted ldrh/strh and size8 owner but were labeled packed; parent inspected candidate.i/.s and returned the actual packed experiment to the same author.
